subject: Generate GIRF for a TVAR with external threshold variable

messages.author: 2699acc28422cf7f
messages.subject: Generate GIRF for a TVAR with external threshold variable
parts:
Hi,

I have estimated a TVAR with an external threshold variable (specified with the thVar element of the TVAR function). 
However, the GIRF function doesn't seem to work if my threshold variable is external to the model. I get the following error, which I think is linked to the TVAR.sim not supporting external threshold variables...
 
>GIRF(TVAR2000.res)
 Error in if (round(z2[i - thDelay], round.dig) <= Thresh) { :   missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed 

Is there any way to generate girf with external threshold variables?

Thanks,
Marion

messages.author: fc37fca39453002a
messages.subject: Re: Generate GIRF for a TVAR with external threshold variable
parts:
Hello, Marion!

I've recently found this great package and have been experimenting with it, so I do not know much about it. But are you using the development version of the package? I remember getting the same error when I tried to use the standalone version of this function. I was able to run the GIRF function with the development version of the package, although I can't seem to distinguish the GIRF's between the regimes (in fact, if anyone knows how to do this, I would be very grateful).
Just in case, the latest development version of the package can be installed with following code:

library(remotes)
install_github("MatthieuStigler/tsDyn/tsDyn", ref = "Dev94", force = T)

Hope I could help somehow!

Regards,
Luan
